Rooms.Name: A black square
Rooms.Description:
You have seen many strange things in the World of Elite - 
gnomes, fairies, hobgoblins, orcs, imps, ancient trees, gishs, a can 
that talks - but never could you have imagined what lies before you.  
Apparently, two very powerful illusionists have conjured life-size 
chess pieces to match their wits against each other.  The landscape 
is large slabs of marble fit snugly together to form a huge 
chessboard.  Far in the distance, you notice that the ground appears 
to be a flat surface of wood.  A table?  All around you are illusions 
of pawns, bishops, knights, rooks, queens and kings.  All of whom 
yearn for battle!

Mobs.Name: white pawn
Mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the light realm is here waiting for orders.
Mobs.Description:
This white pawn looks quite patriotic. He stands ready to give his life for the
Crown.

Mobs.Name: white pawn
Mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the light realm is rushing to the opposite side.
Mobs.Description:
This white pawn looks quite brave. He wants to reach the other side so that
Malthus can get another rook.

Mobs.Name: white pawn
Mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the light realm is here, trying not to be noticed.
Mobs.Description:
This white pawn looks like a wimp. He is here praying that Malthus doesn't
sacrifice him...pathetic, isn't it?

Mobs.Name: white pawn
Mobs.ShortDescription: a pawn of the white court
Mobs.LongDescription: A pawn is here, cursing Malthus.
Mobs.Description: This white pawn looks quite angry. He is upset that Malthus has sacrificed him.

Mobs.Name: priest white bishop
Mobs.LongDescription: A priest of the light realm stands here.
Mobs.Description:
He seems willing to send you to Heaven so he can help you reach a higher
spirituality. He wields a powerful mace for just such a purpose.

Mobs.Name: white knight
Mobs.LongDescription: A knight of the light realm stands here.
Mobs.Description:
Here stands a magnificent knight of the light realm. It seems he wants you to
take a close look at his sharp lance.

Mobs.Name: white rook castle
Mobs.LongDescription: A large, white stone castle is scouting the area.
Mobs.Description:
This white rook is a very large man-made tomb on wheels. Just from the looks of
it, it will probably be YOUR tomb.

Mobs.Name: white queen
Mobs.LongDescription: The queen of the light realm stands here.
Mobs.Description:
The white queen is a stunningly beautiful woman with pale skin and a mass of
light hair that frames her head like the sun.  This is surely love at first
sight for you.

Mobs.Name: white king
Mobs.LongDescription: The king of the light realm is here, trying to hide from danger.
Mobs.Description:
The white king looks like a wimp. He keeps peering around, apparently in
hopes of spoting a rook to hide behind. You wonder why Malthus made him the
king instead of you..

Mobs.Name: black pawn
Mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the dark realm is here waiting for orders.
Mobs.Description:
This black pawn looks quite patriotic. He stands ready to give his life for the
Crown.

Mobs.Name: black pawn
Mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the dark realm is rushing to the opposite side.
Mobs.Description:
The black pawn looks quite brave. He wants to reach the other side so that
Turing can get another rook.

Mobs.Name: black pawn
Mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the dark realm is here, trying not to be noticed.
Mobs.Description:
The black pawn looks like a wimp. He is here praying that Turing doesn't
sacrifice him...pathetic, isn't it?

Mobs.Name: black pawn
Mobs.LongDescription: A pawn of the dark realm is here, cursing Turing.
Mobs.Description:
The black pawn looks quite angry. He is upset that Turing has let him get
captured.

Mobs.Name: priest black bishop
Mobs.LongDescription: A priest of the dark realm stands here.
Mobs.Description:
He seems willing to help you straight into your grave so that he can properly
bless you.

Mobs.Name: black knight
Mobs.LongDescription: A knight of the dark realm stands here.
Mobs.Description:
Here stands a magnificent knight of the dark realm. He seems to want you to
take a close look at his powerful lance.

Mobs.Name: black rook castle
Mobs.LongDescription: A large, black stone castle is here, looking for someone to kill.
Mobs.Description:
The black rook is a very large man-made tomb on wheels. Just from the looks of
it, it will probably be YOUR tomb.

Mobs.Name: black queen
Mobs.LongDescription: The queen of the dark realm stands here.
Mobs.Description:
The black queen is a stunningly beautiful woman with dark skin and a mass of
dark hair that crowns her head like a black cloud. If looks could kill, you'd
already be dead!

Mobs.Name: black king
Mobs.LongDescription: The king of the dark realm is here, trying to avoid capture.
Mobs.Description:
The Black King looks like a wimp. He is keeps peering around, apparently in
constant fear of being captured. You wonder why Turing made him the king
instead of you.

Mobs.Name: hermes official timekeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: Hermes is here, staring at the hourglass.
Mobs.Description:
Hermes looks happy. The last grains of sand are about to drop down from the top
portion of the hour glass. Turing's reached his time limit, so in a moment,
Hermes may get to forfeit black's move.

Mobs.Name: hopper official
Mobs.LongDescription: Hopper is here, examining the rules book.
Mobs.Description:
Hopper is here scratching his head. He's not sure if the last move by Malthus
was legal or not..

Mobs.Name: chessmaster grand malthus
Mobs.LongDescription: Malthus is here, patiently twiddling his thumbs.
Mobs.Description:
Malthus is legendary for his masterful skill at playing chess. This Grand
Chessmaster looks smart, but not half as smart as RIGEL. Apparently, he went
last and is now waiting for Turing to respond.

Mobs.Name: chessmaster grand turing
Mobs.LongDescription: Turing is here, wondering how she can save both queen without losing a pawn.
Mobs.Description:
Turing is one of the greatest chessmasters ever. She looks smart, maybe even
smarter than IO! She'll need all of her wits if she's going to escape from the
trap Malthus set without loosing any pieces.
